name: context-gauge
description: Band above the prompt showing context usage by category and the prompt-cache countdown

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives after the last response (1h normally, 5m under usage overage)

warnMinutes.title: Warn before cache expiry (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Toast this many minutes before the cache expires; 0 turns the toast off
